name: Alysanne Hightower
title: Lady Alysanne Hightower of Oldtown

relationships.timos-hightower: Her younger brother; she watched him die in the Great Hall moments before the chaos below claimed her too.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Watched him arrive at Oldtown's gates from a window above, unaware it would be the last thing she ever saw of the outside world.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Her younger sister, who was pinned to the Great Hall floor beside her when the massacre began — and, unlike Alysanne, survived it.

summary: Alysanne Hightower appeared only briefly, a silhouette in a high window watching Prince Gaelor's vanguard arrive at her family's gates. She and her sister were pinned to the floor as the Great Hall dissolved into violence, and in the blind panic that followed, a soldier's blade found her. Her death, unintended and unremarked upon by the men who caused it, is one of Oldtown's quietest tragedies.

name: Baelenys Targaryen
title: King of the Seven Kingdoms
goals: Preserve the Iron Throne
Crush internal betrayal
Win the coming war
Keep House Targaryen united under his rule
Hunt down his exiled brother Vahaemon before his name becomes a banner for dissidents
See Gaelor lead the Stepstones campaign

relationships.jaery-targaryen: Trusts her more than most, but rarely lets her influence his decisions; struck her in a moment of drunken fury and has not acknowledged it since.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Formerly his most trusted heir. That trust has been shattered, and Visenor now faces exile or the Wall should he ever return.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Sees growing potential in him and has named him heir should Visenor not return; though Gaelor's massacre at Oldtown embarrassed the Crown, the King accepts full responsibility for the order that caused it.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Respects his intelligence and has made him Hand of the King, though he still despises his constant opposition. During the worst of the family's fracturing, confessed to Jace that he sees himself reflected in his son's relentless need to prove himself — and that this is not a compliment.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Increasingly distrustful, though he still relies on her for delicate diplomatic errands; has begun to consider using her dragon for the campaign against Vahaemon.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: Considers her a political liability and the daughter of a traitor he has never forgiven.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: His exiled brother, now believed to be sheltering in the Free Cities with a dragon of his own — a fact that has consumed the King's council and his paranoia in equal measure.
relationships.malaenar-targaryen: His elder brother, whose nameday brought the family to Dragonstone and their oldest wounds back to the surface; by the end of the night they stood together on the balcony, which is the closest these two get to peace.
relationships.derrin-hightower: His oldest friend and, until his execution, his most trusted Hand — a betrayal that cut deeper than the poison itself.
relationships.curtass-whent: Recalled him from obscurity and hired him in secret to retrieve Prince Visenor; received word of his death with cold indifference.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: His uncle, recalled to court and elevated to Grand Maester after the Oldtown Massacre — though the two clashed immediately over his handling of the affair.
relationships.naella-velaryon: Received news of her pregnancy with rare, genuine warmth — one of the few unguarded moments of tenderness in an otherwise bleak season.
relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: She admires him without understanding the fear he inspires in everyone else; he has shown her only the softest side of himself.
relationships.orwell-morrigen: Commands the Kingsguard in his name; Morrigen serves with rigid, unquestioning discipline.
relationships.steffon-baratheon: Holds House Baratheon in high esteem for past military service, entirely unaware of the young lord's insolence before the Hand's throne.
relationships.cordin-poole: Replaced him as Grand Maester with Baelor Targaryen; still keeps Cordin on the council for administrative continuity, though he treats him with barely concealed contempt.

summary: King Baelenys has ruled the realm through fear, strength, and absolute authority. The poisoning attempt transformed him even further, earning him the name 'Baelenys the Formidable.' Once capable of calculated restraint, he now sees traitors in every shadow. The revelation of Rhaella's secret correspondence with his own exiled brother Vahaemon shattered his already fragile trust in his children, especially Visenor, whom he struck down before the entire court and gave an impossible choice: kill his wife, or lose everything. Having named Jacaelon his new Hand after Derrin Hightower's treason and secret execution, Baelenys now moves toward war with House Tyrell, Hightower, and ultimately his own exiled brother with the same merciless certainty that has defined his reign. His drunken violence against Queen Jaery and the drawn sword leveled at his own sons in a midnight corridor suggest a man whose grip on himself is loosening even as his grip on the realm tightens.

name: Baelor Targaryen
title: Grand Maester
goals: Advise the Crown before its impulsiveness costs it everything
Prevent a wider war with the Reach
Guide Jacaelon, in whom he sees a reflection of himself
Funnel Vahaemon south toward Tyrosh and end the succession threat without open war
Convince Saera to commit her dragon to the campaign against Vahaemon

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: His great-nephew and King, who summoned him back from the Citadel after years of self-imposed exile and named him Grand Maester in Cordin's place; the two clash constantly over the Oldtown Massacre and the handling of Vahaemon.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: The King himself compares the two as kindred spirits — scholars and dissenters born into a family of warriors. Baelor embraced him warmly upon arrival and found, to his relief, the sharpest mind at the council table.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Greeted warmly on the road from Oldtown, though visibly and vocally horrified upon learning of the massacre; called the decision to send two thousand men to execute a fifteen-year-old boy flawed from its very inception.
relationships.cordin-poole: Displaced him as Grand Maester, though the two continue to work together on the council's finances.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Working with Jace to convince her to commit Cloudgazer to the Tyrosh campaign, framing it as a war of liberation rather than a war of succession.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: Spent years accumulating research on the Targaryen Dreamers while at Oldtown, some of which Visenor later discovered in an unmailed letter at the scholars' retreat near Starfall; that research now belongs to the fugitive prince.

summary: Decades ago, Baelor Targaryen forsook his own claim to the Iron Throne for a quieter life of study at the Citadel, earning a reputation as 'the argumentative one' of his generation — a title the King now pointedly applies to his own son Jacaelon. Recalled to King's Landing amid the Tyrell-Hightower treason crisis, Baelor arrived too late to stop Gaelor's bloody campaign in the Reach and rode for the Red Keep in open alarm. Named Grand Maester in Cordin's place, he has since thrown himself into the Vahaemon problem with characteristic thoroughness: engineering Vahaemon's expulsion from Braavos through economic pressure, and planning to repeat the tactic in Pentos before funneling his exiled nephew toward Tyrosh where the Crown can end the succession threat with dragonfire rather than diplomacy.

name: Brandon Stark
title: Late Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North

relationships.rickard-stark: His son and heir, who inherited Winterfell and its burdens upon his death.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Their houses shared an old, uneasy loyalty; his own father bled for the Iron Throne beside Baelenys' uncle.

summary: Lord Brandon Stark died quietly in his own bed while the royal court feasted at Driftmark, a small, undramatic death that nonetheless drew King's Landing's attention back to the North for the first time in years. His passing brought Princess Saera to Winterfell to pay the Crown's respects, and with her, the first real contact between Stark and Targaryen in a generation.

name: Cordin Poole
title: Maester
goals: Preserve his position at court after his demotion
Avoid the King's wrath
Offer counsel that offends no one
Curry favor with Gaelor as the likely eventual king

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Served him faithfully for decades, though the King replaced him as Grand Maester with Baelor Targaryen after the Oldtown Massacre; still sits on the small council.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: A frequent target of the Hand's sharpest sarcasm for his fawning, empty flattery; was silenced mid-sentence with a single raised hand during the Stepstones council debate.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Openly courts his favor, fawning over his military decisions in council in a manner that visibly irritates Jace.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: Displaced by his return; the two now work together on the council's finances despite the demotion. Cordin manages the indignity with practiced, empty grace.

summary: Maester Cordin Poole has served House Targaryen faithfully for decades, and it shows in every carefully hedged word he offers the small council. He rarely disagrees with the King and even more rarely survives an exchange with Jacaelon's tongue unscathed. Since the Oldtown Massacre, King Baelenys replaced him as Grand Maester with the newly returned Baelor Targaryen, though Cordin remains on the council. Yet beneath the sycophancy occasionally surfaces an uncomfortable truth — as when he coldly reminded the council that sons sometimes pay the price for their fathers' ambitions, leaving Jace briefly unable to argue back.

name: Curtass Whent
title: Former Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Summoned back into royal service and hired in secret to track down and retrieve Prince Visenor, dead or alive.
relationships.alester-dayne: Ambushed him and Visenor's party in the Dornish woods with five sellswords; the fight that followed was one of the most brutal in either man's life. Whent died when Alester squeezed the warhorse's testicles, causing the animal to buck and cave in his jaw with an iron-shod kick.
relationships.saathos-maris: Sent by Baelor Targaryen to investigate his death near the rural sept south of King's Landing; Saathos's inquiries confirmed the broad strokes of the ambush but could not identify the knight who survived it.

summary: Once a Kingsguard whose exploits were sung about before most knights would dare dream of it, Curtass Whent left the order under circumstances the realm no longer discusses openly. King Baelenys called him back for one purpose: find Visenor. He very nearly succeeded, cornering Ser Alester Dayne with five sellswords in the woods south of King's Landing. The fight cost him his life at the hooves of his own target's horse — killed not by a sword, but by a desperate, dying act of improvisation from the man he had just beaten half to death. His body was found alongside those of his five sellswords near a rural sept, and word of his death reached the King, who received it with cold indifference.

name: Darren Dayne
title: Lord of Torrentine
goals: Safeguard House Dayne's holdings along the Torrentine
Keep his children away from King's Landing's wars
Preserve Dorne's neutrality in the Crown's troubles

relationships.lorenah-dayne: His daughter, whom he has tried, and largely failed, to keep sheltered from the intrigues of the crown.

summary: The quiet Lord of Torrentine, Darren Dayne has stayed carefully out of King's Landing's politics for most of his life, content to let his daughter Lorenah manage House Dayne's more delicate affairs. Neither he nor his seat ever expected to become entangled in sheltering a fugitive Crown Prince, but that is precisely what his family's choices have made of them.

name: Derrin Hightower
title: Former Hand of the King
traits: Genuinely Loyal in His Own Broken Way

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Old friend and, until his fall, the King's most trusted Hand — a friendship of thirty years he betrayed for a cause he sincerely believed was greater than both of them.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: The prince who exposed his treason, led him into a locked room at Driftmark under false pretenses, extracted his full confession — including the name of the Lord of Highgarden — and executed him on the spot before disposing of the body at sea.
relationships.timos-hightower: His son, condemned and killed for a treason he never had any part in.
relationships.alysanne-hightower: His daughter, killed in the chaos that followed his son's execution — an unintended consequence of the treason he set in motion.
relationships.melessa-hightower: His surviving daughter, whose life was spared only by chance in the Oldtown massacre.
relationships.the-lord-of-highgarden: His co-conspirator; it was the Lord of Highgarden who first approached him with the plan to poison the King, sharing his belief that the realm could not survive another of Baelenys's wars.

summary: For decades Derrin Hightower served as Baelenys' Hand and closest political adviser. After the poisoning attempt, he became the center of suspicion when the dying assassin allegedly whispered only two words: 'the Hand.' Confronted alone by Jacaelon at Driftmark, Derrin confessed everything: he had conspired with the Lord of Highgarden to poison the King, believing the realm could no longer survive Baelenys' wars and taxes, and that he acted for House Targaryen's future rather than against it. Jace executed him on the spot and disposed of his body at sea. To the realm, Derrin Hightower remains simply missing — his true fate known only to the King, his new Hand, and the sea.

name: Gaelor Targaryen
title: Prince Gaelor of House Targaryen
goals: Prove himself worthy of Blackfyre and the throne
Crush the Tyrell-Hightower conspiracy
Lead the campaign to take the Stepstones
Uncover who the 'blonde knight' was that killed Curtass Whent
Keep Maela's secret buried permanently

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: His loyalty has brought him closer to the King, who has named him heir should Visenor not return; he accepts full responsibility for the Oldtown Massacre on Gaelor's behalf, though neither man fully forgives the other for it.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Their rivalry came to a public, bloody climax in the tourney lists — neither could unhorse the other without destroying himself in the process. They lay side by side in the Red Keep's infirmary afterward, trading exhausted insults until they fell back asleep.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Frustrated by what he sees as weakness, though it was Gaelor who beat the poisoner's confession out of the dying assassin himself.
relationships.saathos-maris: Trusted knight, mentor, and drinking companion who indulges his temper more than he probably should; dispatched south to investigate Curtass Whent's death.
relationships.naella-velaryon: His wife since their wedding at Driftmark; he has found unexpected comfort and honesty in their marriage. She is now carrying his child — the first genuinely joyful news he has had in months.
relationships.timos-hightower: Executed him personally at Oldtown to enforce the King's justice — a killing that spiraled into a massacre he did not fully intend and cannot entirely escape.
relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: The little princess he has promised will always be his most loved, however many nieces and nephews may follow; she, in turn, defends him against everyone in the family who calls him a monster.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: Greeted his great-uncle warmly on the road back from Oldtown, before Baelor's visible horror at the massacre made clear how badly the campaign had been received.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Rarely in open conflict, but her disgust after the Oldtown Massacre was plain; she called him a deranged psychopath before the King.
relationships.maela-targaryen: Discovered her in flagrant violation of her Kingsguard's vows and handled the aftermath himself — brutally and permanently — without ever telling her what he did to Vance. The secret sits between them like a drawn sword.
relationships.brannyn-vance: Found him in Maela's bed, dragged him to the black cells, and killed him with Blackfyre in a humiliating, methodical execution that no one else witnessed.
relationships.cordin-poole: Accepts his fawning with the casual pleasure of a man who has recently run out of people willing to flatter him.
relationships.brant-costayne: The Oldtown knight who survived the massacre and took his revenge in the tourney lists — driving a sword through Gaelor's warhorse's chest before being subdued by Ser Blackwood and taken to the black cells.
relationships.godfrey-blackwood: Tackled Costayne in the tourney lists when the knight's assassination attempt threatened to end Gaelor's life; Gaelor owes him a debt he has not yet named.

summary: A natural warrior rather than a statesman, Gaelor's courage often outruns his judgment. His brutal investigation into the poisoning uncovered the dying accusation against the Hand, yet he concealed that revelation even from his siblings. After King Baelenys stripped Blackfyre from Visenor and bestowed it upon him, Gaelor married Naella Velaryon at Driftmark and was named heir should his brother not return. Sent to Oldtown to demand Hightower blood for Derrin's treason, he beheaded young Lord Timos Hightower when the boy panicked, triggering a massacre that slaughtered every Hightower knight present and killed two of Derrin's daughters in the chaos. Back in King's Landing, he privately executed Ser Brannyn Vance for breaking his vows with Princess Maela. He and Jace very nearly destroyed each other in the tourney lists before collapsing within yards of one another — and began speaking again only in the infirmary, from opposite beds, too broken to sustain hatred.

name: Jacaelon Targaryen
title: Prince Jacaelon of House Targaryen, Hand of the King, Ser
traits: Quietly Haunted by What He Has Done
goals: Earn Baelenys' respect
Protect House Targaryen, whatever the cost
Consolidate his power as Hand of the King
Build a powerful spy network
Bring Visenor and Rhaella home safely, in secret
Uncover the full extent of the Tyrell-Hightower conspiracy
Establish back-channel communication with Starfall without implicating Lorenah
Identify what his cousin Visenya is doing in King's Landing and whose orders she follows

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: A complicated love-hate relationship driven by a desperate need for approval — one his father finally granted him by naming him Hand, and then complicated again by the King's drunken, drawn-sword breakdown in the corridor.
relationships.maela-targaryen: His twin and emotional anchor; the person he is most protective of and least honest with.
relationships.saera-targaryen: One of the few siblings he genuinely trusts; she sees through his composure more readily than almost anyone.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Once looked down on him and considered him weak; risking everything to save him and Rhaella changed that completely.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Their rivalry came to a bloody climax in the tourney lists; they have spoken to each other from infirmary beds since, and the King has commanded them to make peace.
relationships.alester-dayne: His closest friend, mentor, and the man he sent into mortal danger to save Visenor. Alester knighted him in a private ceremony — the only honor Jace has ever asked for that was not given by the crown.
relationships.derrin-hightower: Exposed his treason, extracted his confession in private, and executed him himself. Only the King knows the truth.
relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: The little princess who feels safest in his hands; he has tasked Weylar Rocke with quietly finding her a tutor before her admiration of the King's cruelty becomes something else entirely.
relationships.weylar-rocke: His personal spymaster, pardoned from the black cells to ensure loyalty born of terror; first brought him news of Gaelor's brothel visit, and more recently delivered early warning of the Oldtown Massacre's worst details.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: Embraced him warmly on arrival and considers him the one voice at council that matches his own measured counsel.
relationships.orwell-morrigen: Trained under him rigorously during Alester's absence; Morrigen assessed him ready for knighthood, though it was Alester who ultimately performed the ceremony.
relationships.steffon-baratheon: Humiliated him publicly before the court when the young lord came demanding debt repayment from the Crown; unhorsed him in the tourney lists and the insult still burns on both sides.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: Spent an evening in disguise together through the streets of Flea Bottom; she kissed him at her door when they returned. The conversation that preceded it was the most honest one he has had in months.
relationships.visenya-targaryen: His cousin, Vahaemon's daughter — who climbed into his bed in a Flea Bottom brothel believing him to be Gaelor, held Dark Sister to his throat throughout, and vanished before he or Alester could catch her. The encounter left a cut on his neck and a great deal of unanswered questions.
relationships.godfrey-blackwood: Met him in the tourney lists and unhorsed him in a hard-fought six-pass tilt; Blackwood congratulated him graciously in the dirt.
relationships.edmyn-uller: The Dornish maester at the scholars' retreat whose frankness about events in the realm — delivered by raven — proved unexpectedly useful.

summary: Prince Jacaelon has become one of the kingdom's sharpest political minds despite his young age. During the poisoning crisis he uncovered Rhaella's secret correspondence, orchestrated investigations against the Hand, protected Visenor despite publicly humiliating him, and secretly arranged his escape to Dorne through Ser Alester Dayne. He confirmed Derrin Hightower's treason with forged evidence and a confession extracted in a locked room at Driftmark — then executed the old Hand himself and hid the body at sea. Rewarded with the Hand's pin by his own mother, Jace now rules much of the realm's day-to-day business at his father's side. He was knighted privately by Alester Dayne — his only request — and entered the tourney lists to prove his worth before the whole realm, nearly killing Gaelor and nearly being killed in turn before both princes collapsed in the dirt. His greatest current crisis is not political but personal: his cousin Visenya Targaryen walked into his bed in Flea Bottom with Dark Sister at her hip and answers only to herself.

name: Jaery Targaryen
title: Queen of the Seven Kingdoms
goals: Keep the royal family together
Prevent Baelenys from destroying the family from within
Secure strong marriages for her remaining children
Find out what happened to Visenor

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Often the last voice able to temper the King's fury, though even she has limits; he struck her in a drunken rage and she withdrew from his bed for three days before Baelor persuaded her to return.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Pinned the Hand's badge to his chest herself, telling him plainly that she is proud of him — one of the few moments anyone in the family has said so directly.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Reminds him constantly that he is heir now, and that a prince wandering the city until dawn reeking of wine is unacceptable; loves him fiercely even while despairing of his judgment.
relationships.maela-targaryen: Actively arranging her marriage prospects; sent her to Storm's End to meet the Young Stag and considers the visit at least diplomatically productive.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Desperate for news of her missing son; wept openly and begged Jace to keep searching.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Scolded her for lingering a week longer than expected at Winterfell, though her concern was exhaustion more than true anger.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: Leaned on him during the worst of the family's fracturing; Baelor urged her gently to return to the King's side, and she listened.
relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: Her youngest, whom she shelters as much as possible from the ugliness radiating out of the throne room.

summary: Queen Jaery rarely speaks during court, yet her presence is often the last barrier between Baelenys and complete fury. She quietly attempts to preserve what remains of the royal family's unity, steering her children's marriages and futures from behind the scenes even as the realm threatens to come apart around her. It was Jaery, not the King, who publicly recognized Jacaelon's new role as Hand — and who insisted the smallfolk would not pay for Gaelor's wedding. The King's drunken violence against her in his solar was a line she has not forgiven, even if Baelor eventually persuaded her back to his side.

name: Lorenah Dayne
title: Lady Lorenah Dayne of Torrentine
goals: Protect House Dayne's neutrality without appearing to take sides
Shelter Visenor and Rhaella without dragging Starfall into open war
Build something genuine with Jacaelon, or at least understand what he is
Return to Dorne before King's Landing politics consume her entirely

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Trusted enough to become his fugitive family's last resort in Dorne; now a guest at King's Landing, where a night spent together in disguise through Flea Bottom ended with a kiss at her door and a conversation neither of them has entirely recovered from. She has agreed to stay for the tourney and carry his favor.
relationships.alester-dayne: A distant cousin from another branch of House Dayne; her household's network almost certainly saved his life, and she managed his unauthorized role in the whole affair with characteristic competence.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Granted him and Rhaella sanctuary at Starfall fully aware of what it could cost House Dayne if discovered; told him plainly that at some point he will have to leave.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: Provided her sanctuary at Starfall and dispatched a maid and a maester to the scholars' retreat, asking nothing in return.

summary: Young daughter of House Dayne, Lorenah met Prince Jacaelon during his journey through Dorne shortly before the poisoning crisis in King's Landing. That connection became far more consequential than either expected when her distant cousin Ser Alester Dayne arrived at Starfall half-dead and escorting the fugitive Crown Prince. Lorenah took them in without hesitation, fully aware of the cost if the truth ever surfaced. She has since traveled to King's Landing at the head of a diplomatic envoy, bringing a battered Alester home and spending an evening in disguise with Jace through Flea Bottom — eating fish stew with their hands, reading fortunes for street children, and talking about peace between Dorne and the dragons with a candor neither of them can quite manage inside the castle walls.

name: Maela Targaryen
title: Princess Maela of House Targaryen
goals: Keep control over her own future, marriage included
Protect Jace, even from himself
Bury the secret of what happened with Vance
Survive whatever Gaelor did on her behalf without having to be grateful for it

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Her twin and his greatest emotional vulnerability; she told him plainly that he won the tourney tilt even as he lay in the infirmary.
relationships.brannyn-vance: Her sworn Kingsguard shield; she initiated the affair that destroyed him and now carries the weight of not knowing exactly what Gaelor did afterward.
relationships.steffon-baratheon: Charmed by his awkward, oblivious chivalry at Storm's End, though she has no real interest in becoming his lady; laughed aloud when he offered to fetch her a dragon from Dragonstone.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: He discovered her with Vance and handled it without her permission or input; the secret and his methods sit between them like a threat neither has yet made explicit. She threw scalding moon tea in his face and does not consider them even.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Named his surviving hatchling Jadefyre before his flight; the dragon was gifted to her by royal decree after the other two died.
relationships.jaery-targaryen: Her mother actively arranged marriage prospects and ultimately sent her to Storm's End; Maela went, played her part, and returned hollow.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Suspects something is wrong with Maela that predates the tourney; has not yet found the right moment to press.

summary: Born only two minutes before Jace, Maela shares an unusually close bond with her twin. Clever, charismatic, and naturally manipulative, she was gifted Jadefyre after the other two hatchlings of Visenor's clutch died of grotesque birth defects. Pressured by her mother to consider suitors, she used a visit to Storm's End to entertain the earnest Steffon Baratheon while quietly seducing her own Kingsguard, Ser Brannyn Vance — then drank moon tea in secret to ensure the night left no trace. Gaelor found them, killed Vance in the black cells with Blackfyre, and kept the secret. Maela is still not certain which of those facts frightens her more.

name: Malaenar Targaryen
title: Lord of Dragonstone
goals: Hold Dragonstone quietly in the King's name
Remain above the intrigues consuming his brother's children
Avoid ever repeating his other brother's fate

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: His younger brother and King; their nameday reunion on Dragonstone devolved into a screaming match over old wounds — Vahaemon's treason, their father's violence against their mother, and Malaenar's choice to stand aside during the succession crisis. By the end of the evening they were drinking together on the balcony, which for this family constitutes reconciliation.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: His other brother, whose treason and exile still cast a long shadow over the family name.
relationships.tansy-riverside: His companion of two years, who organized the nameday feast that summoned the royal family without telling him first; he was heavily drunk throughout and seemed more amused than alarmed by the chaos that followed.

summary: The eldest of Aenys Targaryen II's three sons, Malaenar renounced his own claim to the Iron Throne due to an infirmity and has held Dragonstone quietly and competently ever since. Standing between a brother who wears the crown and one who wears the name 'Traitor,' Malaenar's unremarkable steadiness has become its own kind of virtue — he is the one Targaryen sibling of his generation nobody has ever had reason to distrust.

name: Naella Velaryon
title: Princess Naella of House Velaryon
goals: Support Gaelor through the weight of his new position as heir
Bear a healthy child
Persuade him to let his rivalry with Jace go before it kills one of them

relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Her husband since their wedding at Driftmark; she sees past his bravado to the weight he carries as heir. She is now carrying his child — news she brought to him directly, and then to the King herself.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Told the King herself that she was with child; he received the news with an awkward but sincere paternal warmth — a pat on the cheek and two words of approval.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Sat at Gaelor's bedside in the infirmary after the tourney tilt, insisting that Costayne had cheated and that Gaelor was fighting crippled; holds Jace entirely responsible for the damage.

summary: Daughter of House Velaryon, Naella married Prince Gaelor in a lavish ceremony at Driftmark's High Tide, an alliance sealed in celebration even as the realm quietly held its breath over a missing Crown Prince. Warm where Gaelor is guarded, she was quick to see through his nerves on their wedding day and quicker still to earn his honest affection. She is now carrying his child — and re-bandaging his wounds from the tourney with the same steady hands, telling him he was magnificent even while removing splinters from his neck.

name: Rhaella Targaryen
title: Princess Rhaella of House Targaryen

secret.note: Hiding at the scholars' retreat near Starfall with Visenor, under Lorenah Dayne's protection. Pregnant with Visenor's child.

goals: Survive
Protect Visenor
Carry their child safely to term
Reconnect with her family, wherever exile has scattered them

relationships.visenor-targaryen: Loves him deeply despite everything her family's name has cost them both; wept tears of pure happiness when her pregnancy was confirmed.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Lives in constant fear of him, and with good reason.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: Her exiled father, whose disgrace hangs over her at court, though it was not to him that her secret warning was sent — it was to her siblings.
relationships.visenya-targaryen: Her sister, whose current whereabouts and allegiances remain unknown to Rhaella.
relationships.alester-dayne: Watched him nearly die protecting her and Visenor, and has called him a true hero to the realm ever since.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: Received sanctuary from her at Starfall and again at the scholars' retreat, where Lorenah had already dispatched a maid and maester to attend her.
relationships.edmyn-uller: The Dornish maester assigned to attend her at the scholars' retreat; it was under his care that her pregnancy was discovered.

summary: Daughter of the King's own exiled brother Vahaemon Targaryen and wife of Crown Prince Visenor, Rhaella secretly wrote to warn her siblings beyond the realm's borders — a letter that triggered the greatest internal crisis within House Targaryen in a generation. Forced into the center of the poisoning investigation, she fled King's Landing with Visenor under Jace's protection, surviving bandits and a hired hunter before finding sanctuary at Starfall. She now rests at a scholars' retreat in the Dornish hills, pregnant with Visenor's child, safe for the moment and deeply uncertain how long that moment will last.

name: Rickard Stark
title: Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North
goals: Rule the North well in his father's stead
Mend the old, uneasy distance between Winterfell and the Iron Throne
Win Princess Saera's regard

relationships.saera-targaryen: Welcomed her to Winterfell during his mourning and found himself unexpectedly, cautiously drawn to her; told her the realm would like to see more of her, and showed her the Wall.
relationships.brandon-stark: His late father, whose death brought the North and the Iron Throne back into contact after years of quiet distance.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Knows the Crown's history with his house; his grandfather fought beside Baelenys' uncle and his father paid for the throne in blood. Seeks a steadier relationship than either generation managed.

summary: Newly burdened with Winterfell upon his father's death, Rickard Stark received Princess Saera's visit of condolence with the plain, unadorned courtesy the North is known for. What began as diplomacy became something warmer by the time he showed her the Wall, though neither of them dared name it. Rickard hopes the visit marks the beginning of a steadier peace between his house and the dragons who once fought beside his grandfather.

name: Saera Targaryen
title: Princess Saera of House Targaryen
goals: Maintain the family's fragile unity
Build alliances beyond the capital
Protect Visenor and Rhaella however she can from afar
Resist being weaponized as a dragonrider in a succession war she did not start
Preserve whatever she found in Winterfell

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Frequently opposes the King's decisions and is the only child willing to do so in open court; called him out publicly over the Oldtown Massacre and earned a threat of the black cells for it.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Works closely with him and is one of the few people able to see through his composure; spotted his happiness after the Flea Bottom evening with Lorenah and named it before he admitted it to himself.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Supported him during the Rhaella affair and helped shield the truth from their father as long as she could.
relationships.rickard-stark: Sent north to offer the Crown's condolences, she found an unexpected warmth in his company; lingered a full week beyond her expected return.
relationships.alester-dayne: Waited for him to come to her rather than going to him after his battered return to court; allowed herself a late-night walk with him and quietly resumed an old habit neither has named.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Called him a deranged psychopath before the King after the Oldtown Massacre; the relationship has not recovered.
relationships.maela-targaryen: Suspects something is wrong beneath her sister's hollow composure; has not yet learned what.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: Working alongside him to find a way to frame the Tyrosh campaign that Saera might actually agree to; she remains resistant to being used as a weapon in a war of succession.

summary: Known throughout the realm as 'Cloud Eyes,' Saera's mysterious gaze has only grown cloudier over time. Quiet yet perceptive, she commands unusual affection from dragons and smallfolk alike. Sent to Winterfell to honor Lord Brandon Stark's death, she lingered a full week longer than expected, drawn to the new Lord Rickard Stark and to a North quieter and more honest than anything she has known in King's Landing. Back at court, she confronted the King openly over the Oldtown Massacre, survived the threat, and now finds herself at the center of a plan to use her dragon against Vahaemon in Tyrosh — a plan she has not yet agreed to.

name: Ser Alester Dayne
title: Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard
goals: Protect Jace
Bring Visenor and Rhaella to safety
Honor House Dayne
Survive long enough to answer for abandoning his post
Not ruin whatever is growing between himself and Princess Saera by rushing it

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Best friend, sworn protector, and the man he knighted in a private ceremony the night before the tourney — the only ceremony either of them wanted.
relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: The little princess adores him and did not stop asking after him the entire time he was gone; he owes her several stories.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Escorted him and Rhaella out of King's Landing under cover of darkness and nearly died protecting them twice over; considers the debt repaid by Visenor's own courage through the journey.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: A distant cousin whose protection at Starfall likely saved both his life and the fugitive prince's; she knew his role long before he admitted it.
relationships.curtass-whent: Ambushed by him and five sellswords in the Dornish woods; Whent beat him nearly to death before a desperate act involving the warhorse's testicles ended the fight. The ugliest duel of his life.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Sought her out the night of his return; she had been waiting. They resumed their old habit of walking the corridors together, and she allowed it without making him ask twice.
relationships.orwell-morrigen: His Lord Commander, whose patience with his unauthorized absence has worn thin; the matter of what to do about it has not yet been formally resolved.
relationships.steffon-baratheon: Faced him in the tourney semi-finals in what witnesses called one of the finest jousts the realm had seen in years; lost in the final pass to a two-handed lance thrust to the gut, and shook the man's hand from the dirt.
relationships.saathos-maris: Traded barbed pleasantries with him in the infirmary; the two understand each other's roles perfectly and trust each other roughly as far as their princes allow.

summary: Ser Alester Dayne is Prince Jacaelon's closest friend and sworn protector. Silent, observant, and capable in combat beyond almost any man in the realm, he acted as the physical execution arm of Jace's plans throughout the poisoning crisis: uncovering Rhaella's secret correspondence, defying the Hand during the dungeon confrontation, and ultimately smuggling Visenor and Rhaella out of King's Landing toward Dorne. The journey nearly killed him. Ambushed in the woods by Curtass Whent and five hired sellswords, Alester fought through brutal, sustained violence before killing Whent in a final, desperate act. He returned to King's Landing battered but breathing, knighted Jace in private the night before the tourney, watched him unhorse Godfrey Blackwood in the lists, and then fell in the semi-finals to Steffon Baratheon in a joust the crowd will not soon forget. His unauthorized absence from court remains unresolved with Lord Commander Morrigen.

name: Ser Brannyn Vance
title: Former Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard

relationships.maela-targaryen: Sworn to protect her with his life; broke his sacred vows for her in a single night and confessed, under threat, that she initiated the affair. Did not fight back when Gaelor came for him.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Discovered, dragged to the black cells, and executed with Blackfyre in a humiliating fight Vance refused to fully participate in. He asked only to die with some remnant of honor. He was not given it.

summary: Ser Brannyn Vance served as Princess Maela's sworn shield long enough to become someone she trusted with more than her safety. He broke his Kingsguard vows in a single night in Storm's End and spent the journey home wracked with guilt, terrified of what came next. What came next was Prince Gaelor — through the door, across the room, and eventually down to the black cells. Vance died on Blackfyre's edge, castrated and then killed, having refused on principle to raise steel against royal blood. He is officially listed as a traitor. Only three people know the truth of what happened.

name: Ser Brant Costayne
title: Knight of the Reach

secret.note: Imprisoned in the black cells of the Red Keep following his assassination attempt on Prince Gaelor in the tourney lists. Gaelor has claimed him personally.

goals: Avenge Lord Timos and the knights of Oldtown
Make Gaelor Targaryen answer for the massacre

relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Stood against him at the gates of the Hightower under oath; survived the massacre that followed as one of its few breathing witnesses. Entered the tourney lists disguised as a Riverlands knight, unhorsed Gaelor's horse with a longsword after being unhorsed himself, and came within a stroke of killing the prince before Ser Blackwood tackled him into the mud.
relationships.timos-hightower: Swore to defend him under oath and screamed for his revenge the moment the boy was executed; the grief has not dimmed.

summary: A hard-edged survivor of the Oldtown Massacre, Brant Costayne watched his lord beheaded and his brothers slaughtered and spent the months since looking for a way to make it mean something. He found it in the tourney lists — entering disguised as a Riverlands knight, taking Gaelor's horse with a longsword through the chest after losing his own saddle, and very nearly taking the prince's life before Ser Godfrey Blackwood intervened. He is now in the black cells of the Red Keep, claimed personally by Gaelor, and he went there without resistance. He came to die. He has not yet been permitted to.

name: Ser Orwell Morrigen
title: Lord Commander of the Kingsguard
goals: Hold the Kingsguard together through scandal and desertion
Protect the royal family whatever the cost to his own men
Eventually address what Alester Dayne did and did not do

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Serves him with rigid, unquestioning discipline.
relationships.alester-dayne: Trained him personally; considers him the finest blade he has ever produced. His unauthorized absence protecting Prince Visenor has not gone unnoticed and will not go unpunished forever.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Trained the prince rigorously in Alester's absence; openly assessed him ready for knighthood, told him he could not quite beat Alester yet but was close, and watched Jace choose Alester's hand over his for the ceremony itself. The slight was real. He showed no sign of minding.

summary: Lord Commander Orwell Morrigen has led the Kingsguard through decades of relative peace, none of which prepared him for a poisoning, a vanished heir, and one of his own sworn brothers quietly abandoning his post to smuggle that heir out of the capital. He says little, watches everything, and is running out of patience for secrets he is clearly not being told. He trained both Alester Dayne and Prince Jacaelon; the latter chose his sworn shield's sword over his Lord Commander's for the knighting ceremony, which Morrigen absorbed in silence and has not mentioned since.

name: Ser Saathos Maris
title: Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard
goals: Serve Prince Gaelor faithfully
Keep his prince alive despite his own recklessness
Uncover who the blonde knight was that killed Curtass Whent

relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Sworn knight, loyal protector, and one of the few people willing to needle him with dark humor even in the worst moments; visited him in the infirmary after the tourney tilt and woke him up by slapping his shoulder.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Rode at Gaelor's side through Oldtown and carried out the King's orders.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: Chosen by Baelor to ride south and investigate the deaths of Ser Curtass Whent and his men near the rural sept; his findings confirmed the broad outlines of an ambush but not the identity of the surviving knight.
relationships.alester-dayne: Suspects, based on his investigation of the sept and the description of the surviving blonde knight, that Dayne is connected to Curtass Whent's death; has not yet formally accused anyone. Their infirmary exchange was pleasant and meant nothing at all.

summary: Ser Saathos Maris is the sworn knight of Prince Gaelor Targaryen. Disciplined, dependable, and unwavering in duty, he represents the military backbone of Gaelor's authority. During the poisoning crisis, he assisted in tracking the assassin and later defied political pressure by refusing the Hand entry into the dungeon. He rode at Gaelor's side through the bloody march on Oldtown and the massacre that followed. Sent south by Baelor Targaryen to investigate Curtass Whent's death, he returned with incomplete answers and a growing private suspicion about who the blonde knight at the sept really was — a suspicion he has not yet taken anywhere.

name: Steffon Baratheon
title: Lord of Storm's End
goals: Win the Crown's respect for House Baratheon
Secure a marriage worthy of his house
Prove himself beyond the tourney grounds
Win the tourney — which he did, by default, after neither prince could stand

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Demanded overdue debts from him before the whole court and was humiliated for his trouble; was unhorsed by him in the tourney quarter-finals and correctly assessed that Jace was holding back.
relationships.maela-targaryen: Hosted her at Storm's End and fell for her completely, treating her with an awkward, earnest chivalry that charmed her even as she entertained his Kingsguard; offered to fetch her a dragon from Dragonstone without understanding why she laughed.
relationships.alester-dayne: Faced him in the tourney semi-finals in one of the most brutal jousts in recent memory; won by throwing his own lance away and driving the butt end into Alester's stomach, then ran to his side the moment he fell. They embraced in the dirt to the crowd's approval.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Held in high esteem by the King for his house's past military service; Baelenys remains unaware of the insolence at the Hand's throne.

summary: Already famous in tourneys and duels despite his youth, Steffon Baratheon marched into the Red Keep demanding the Crown repay House Baratheon's old debts in blood and coin, only to be cut down before the court by Hand Jacaelon Targaryen. Weeks later he hosted Princess Maela at Storm's End, showing an earnest, almost childlike chivalry that charmed her without ever earning her heart. He won the King's Landing tourney by default when both princes collapsed in the lists — a hollow victory he was loudly furious about. His joust against Alester Dayne, however, was anything but hollow.

name: Timos Hightower
title: Lord of Oldtown
traits: Tried to Choose Parley Over Pride
goals: Survive the Crown's judgment
Protect his sisters
Preserve what remained of House Hightower's honor

relationships.derrin-hightower: His father, whose secret treason condemned him before he understood what was happening.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Asked him for parley and mercy; drew his sword in panic when the answer became clear; was beheaded.
relationships.alysanne-hightower: His older sister, killed in the same massacre that claimed his life moments later.
relationships.melessa-hightower: His younger sister; she survived the massacre in which he died.
relationships.brant-costayne: The knight who stood in oath to defend him, called for his revenge the moment he was killed, and died in the chaos that followed.

summary: Thrust into Oldtown's lordship the moment his father vanished under suspicion, fifteen-year-old Timos Hightower tried desperately to comply with the Crown's demands. He asked Gaelor to enter with only a few men and speak. It was not enough. When the prince announced his execution, panic drove the boy to draw steel. He never had a chance to use it. His decapitated head rolled to a stop at Gaelor's boots. His death, and the massacre it triggered, will be remembered in the Reach for a hundred years.

name: Tion Lannister
title: Master of Coin
goals: Keep the Crown solvent
Temper the royal family's costlier impulses
Survive the King's temper long enough to matter
Prevent Highgarden's reparations from being immediately poured into a Stepstones war

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Finds an unlikely, if uneasy, ally in the Hand's more measured economic instincts; the two agreed publicly in council that beheading a sixteen-year-old does not mend the Crown's image.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Dismisses his war-hungry proposals as reckless, and is dismissed right back.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Regularly rebuked for prioritizing the treasury over the King's pride; was told to deal with the money and leave the rest to others.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: Works with him on the council's finances; their shared practicality occasionally makes them temporary allies.

summary: As Master of Coin, Tion Lannister spends most small council meetings being outvoted by princes eager for war and glory. He argued against pouring Highgarden's reparations straight into a campaign for the Stepstones, pointing out — correctly, and to no effect — that a war with no clear end is not an investment. He was the only voice at table to agree openly with Jace that executing a fifteen-year-old for his father's treason does not improve the Crown's reputation, a point the King ended by slamming his fist on the table. His counsel is sound and almost never followed.

name: Vahaemon Targaryen
title: Traitor

secret.note: Denied entry to Pentos by Targaryen diplomatic pressure. Has sailed for Tyrosh, where an informant within his camp reports he intends to offer the city the protection of his dragon in exchange for sanctuary and support.

traits: In Possession of Artifacts of House Targaryen
goals: Regain some measure of standing for his name
Protect his daughters from afar
Survive the consequences of his own old betrayal
Avoid being funneled toward Tyrosh by Targaryen pressure

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: His brother and King, who exiled him for treason during the seventh moon of his own reign — a cold war ended decisively, the realm was told, though the full details remain known only to those who lived through it.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: His daughter in exile; her secret letters to her siblings reignited the very suspicion that nearly destroyed her marriage, though the warning was never addressed to him.
relationships.visenya-targaryen: His other daughter, who is apparently neither in exile nor in Essos — but in King's Landing, walking freely through Flea Bottom with Dark Sister at her hip.
relationships.naela-targaryen: His wife; her current whereabouts and condition are unknown.
relationships.malaenar-targaryen: His steady brother, who stayed loyal to Baelenys throughout and whose very steadiness has always been the sharpest rebuke to Vahaemon's choices.

summary: Exiled from Westeros years before the events of the poisoning, Vahaemon Targaryen lives on beyond the Seven Kingdoms' reach, now believed to be in Pentos after the Crown engineered his expulsion from Braavos through economic pressure. He possesses a dragon of unknown origin — a fact that has consumed the small council's planning and Baelor Targaryen's strategy alike. His daughter Rhaella is hidden in Dorne, pregnant with a Targaryen heir. His daughter Visenya has materialized in a Flea Bottom brothel with Dark Sister and a blade at a prince's throat. Whether either development is his doing remains the most urgent unanswered question at the Hand's table.

name: Vhaemys Targaryen
title: Princess Vhaemys of House Targaryen
traits: Parroting the King's Cruelty Without Understanding It

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Admires her father without understanding the fear he inspires in everyone else; cheered openly for Gaelor after the Oldtown Massacre, absorbing the King's framing entirely.
relationships.alester-dayne: Deeply attached to him and often followed him around the castle before his disappearance; she missed him openly and without shame the entire time he was gone.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Feels safest around him, clings to him whenever the family fractures in front of her, and occasionally uses his authority to be difficult with people she dislikes. He has quietly tasked Weylar Rocke with finding her a tutor capable of teaching her empathy.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: He promises her she will always be his most loved, no matter how many nieces and nephews follow; she repaid him by defending him before Jace and Saera in the corridor after the Oldtown news broke.
relationships.jaery-targaryen: Her mother, beside whom she sheltered during the worst of the family's fracturing.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Her older sister, toward whom she gravitates when the castle turns frightening and Jace or Alester are unavailable.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: Took an immediate dislike to her on first meeting in the Godswood and was openly rude; Jace took her to see Jhagar to get her out of the way.

summary: The youngest child of King Baelenys Targaryen. Sheltered from court politics but absorbing its worst lessons anyway, Vhaemys still believes her father can never be defeated and greeted the news of the Oldtown Massacre with cheerful approval that horrified everyone except the King. During the family's worst public fracturing she stomped a harmless beetle in the corridor and did not understand why Jace made it a lesson. He is looking for a tutor. It may already be too late for some of what she has learned.

name: Visenor Targaryen
title: Crown Prince

secret.note: Hiding at the scholars' retreat near Starfall, Dorne, with Rhaella. Rhaella is pregnant. Visenor has made contact with a reclusive dragon named Boneskin in the Red Mountains and successfully bonded with it; the dragon has since relocated to a coastal cave near Starfall. Visenor is aware of Grand Maester Baelor's incomplete research on the Targaryen Dreamers, having found unmailed letters at the retreat.

traits: At Peace for the First Time in His Life
goals: Protect Rhaella and their unborn child
Avoid civil war
Reach safety without becoming a rallying banner for his enemies
Return home a king worth trusting
Deepen his bond with Boneskin
Pursue his discovery of Baelor's research on the Targaryen Dreamers

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Once the King's most trusted child. That trust has now been shattered, along with two of his teeth.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: His greatest love and the reason he gave up everything to flee the capital; she is now carrying their first child.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: His opinion of Jace changed completely after learning of his secret help and the price Ser Alester nearly paid for it.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Often disagrees with his methods, though it was Gaelor who first argued Visenor should never split his clutch of dragons among the family.
relationships.saera-targaryen: One of the siblings he trusts most.
relationships.alester-dayne: The knight who saved his and Rhaella's lives twice over in the woods south of King's Landing, at tremendous personal cost. Visenor embraced him as a friend before he left Starfall.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: Granted him and Rhaella sanctuary despite the very real danger it poses to her own house; he has promised to repay her hospitality when he is in a position to do so.
relationships.maela-targaryen: His sister now carries Jadefyre, the one hatchling of his own clutch to survive.
relationships.edmyn-uller: The blunt Dornish maester at the scholars' retreat who briefed him on events in the realm with startling frankness; Visenor found his unfiltered honesty unexpectedly refreshing.
relationships.boneskin: A lean, pale-scaled dragon of extraordinary intelligence that had been roosting in the Red Mountains near Starfall. After days of patience, shared meals, and Valyrian songs in the mountain air, Visenor earned its trust. Boneskin has since relocated its egg to a coastal cave near Starfall and permitted Visenor to ride.

summary: Raised from childhood to inherit the Iron Throne, Visenor devoted his life to scholarship rather than warfare. The poisoning crisis destroyed his faith that diplomacy could solve almost anything. Forced to choose between his father's trust and his wife's life, he lost both: Baelenys stripped him of Blackfyre before the court and struck him bloody, then demanded he murder Rhaella to regain his place as heir. Visenor chose exile instead. After surviving outlaws and a hired hunter, he found refuge at Starfall through Lady Lorenah Dayne and now rests at a scholars' retreat in the Dornish hills with Rhaella, who is pregnant with their first child. In the weeks since arriving, he has done something no one in King's Landing knows: traveled alone into the Red Mountains, spent days earning the trust of an ancient, reclusive dragon named Boneskin, and flown back at night beneath the clouds with the creature's egg clutched in its own front claws. He is, for the first time in his life, at peace. He has also begun reading Grand Maester Baelor's incomplete and unmailed research on the Targaryen Dreamers. Whatever he found has not left his mind.

name: Weylar Rocke
title: Master of Whisperers to the Hand of the King
goals: Remain indispensable to Jace
Expand his network of informants throughout King's Landing
Never again see the inside of the black cells
Find a suitable tutor for Princess Vhaemys before the King's influence becomes permanent

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: The prince who spared him from the black cells and transformed his terror into absolute, unwavering service. His most recent intelligence — news of Gaelor's brothel visit and word of Visenya Targaryen's presence in Flea Bottom — has proved valuable enough to earn him something approaching genuine standing.

summary: Jace's personal spymaster, and proof that terror makes for sturdier loyalty than trust ever could. Weylar once fed the Prince a hollow report and spent time in the black cells for it; the pardon bought Jace an informant who now bows low enough to scrape the floor. His network has paid off repeatedly: first bringing word of Gaelor's brothel visit days after the wedding, then relaying early confirmation of the Oldtown Massacre. He has since been tasked with finding a tutor for young Vhaemys, a task he approaches with the same mixture of eagerness and dread that characterizes everything he does for the Hand.

name: Edmyn Uller
title: Maester
goals: Tend to his charges at the scholars' retreat
Keep Prince Visenor and Princess Rhaella informed without endangering them

relationships.visenor-targaryen: Tended to his needs at the scholars' retreat near Starfall and briefed him on current events in the realm with startling bluntness; Visenor found his unfiltered delivery unexpectedly refreshing.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: Attended her at the scholars' retreat; discovered and confirmed her pregnancy.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: Dispatched by Lady Dayne to the scholars' retreat to attend the fugitive prince and princess.

summary: A Dornish maester dispatched by Lady Lorenah Dayne to attend Prince Visenor and Princess Rhaella at the scholars' retreat near Starfall. Unimpressed by titles and unusually direct in his delivery, he was the one who confirmed Rhaella's pregnancy and the one who briefed Visenor on the state of the realm — including the massacres, embargoes, and political collapses — with a vocabulary and frankness that made the Crown Prince laugh for the first time in weeks. His Dornish accent is heavy and his tongue is foul, which Visenor described privately as the most honest thing he had encountered since leaving King's Landing.

name: Melessa Hightower
title: Lady of Oldtown
traits: Unnamed in Every Account of That Day
Thirteen Years Old and Already Ruined

relationships.timos-hightower: Her brother; she watched from the same high window as Gaelor's vanguard arrived, and was pinned to the Great Hall floor beside her sister when his execution turned to slaughter.
relationships.alysanne-hightower: Her sister, killed in the same chaos that she herself survived.
relationships.derrin-hightower: Her father, whose treason condemned the entire family long before she ever understood what was happening.

summary: The second of the two Hightower sisters glimpsed watching from a high window as Prince Gaelor's vanguard arrived at Oldtown's gates. Never named in any account of that day, she was tackled to the floor of the Great Hall alongside Alysanne when the massacre began — and, unlike her sister, lived through it. What became of her afterward is not recorded.

name: Visenya Targaryen

secret.note: Was in King's Landing as of the seventeenth day of the seventh moon, 99 AC. Entered a Flea Bottom brothel, held Dark Sister to Prince Jacaelon's throat during a sexual encounter she initiated while believing him to be Gaelor. Fled before Alester Dayne could catch her. Current location unknown.

goals: Determine who she will need to kill when the family's war in Essos begins
Demonstrate to the Red Keep that Vahaemon has friends inside its walls
Retrieve or protect Dark Sister
Return to wherever she came from without being caught

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Mistook him for Gaelor in a Flea Bottom brothel; held Dark Sister to his throat throughout the encounter and left before he or Alester could detain her. Their conversation suggested she is watching the Essos campaign closely.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: Her father; whether she acts under his orders or entirely on her own initiative is the question Jace and Baelor cannot yet answer.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: Her sister, whose current location and condition she presumably does not know.

summary: Daughter of the exiled Vahaemon Targaryen, Visenya materialized in King's Landing on the eve of the grand tourney with a blindfold over her eyes, a jagged scar across her cheek, Dark Sister in a canvas bag, and a working knowledge of where Gaelor Targaryen drinks. She entered a Flea Bottom brothel, climbed into Jacaelon's bed believing him to be his brother, held her ancestral blade to his throat for the duration, and walked out before Alester Dayne could catch her. Her message was the point: the Red Keep has vulnerabilities it does not know about, and Vahaemon Targaryen has either placed them there or has someone clever enough to find them on her own. She is currently unaccounted for. The cut on Jace's neck has healed. The questions have not.

name: Naela Targaryen

secret.note: No information about Naela's current whereabouts or condition is known to the realm.

goals: Unknown

relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: His wife; in exile alongside him, or so it is assumed.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: Her daughter, currently in hiding in Dorne.
relationships.visenya-targaryen: Her daughter, whose current location even Rhaella does not know.

summary: Naela Targaryen, wife of the exiled Vahaemon. Her current whereabouts, health, and disposition are unknown.

name: Godfrey Blackwood
title: Lord Godfrey Blackwood
traits: Openly Unconventional in His Personal Tastes
goals: Build goodwill with the new Hand of the King
Perform creditably in the tourney lists
Enjoy himself without apology
Secure Crown justice for his cousin's death at Bracken hands

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Complimented his tenure as Hand before the tourney and faced him in the quarter-finals in a hard six-pass tilt; was unhorsed cleanly and congratulated Jace from the dirt. Alester reported seeing him descend from an inn's upper rooms flanked by a serving wench and a stableboy, and noted that he makes no secret of his tastes. Brought the Bracken border killing before the Hand's throne; was offered two paths — a Crown envoy or a trial by combat — and accepted both as grounds to wait. Also threatened to ride North to Stark if the Crown failed him, a gambit Jace noted without flinching.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Tackled Ser Brant Costayne into the mud when Costayne drove a sword through Gaelor's horse's chest and attempted to murder the prince — an intervention that likely saved Gaelor's life and has not yet been formally acknowledged.

summary: A well-traveled lord from the Riverlands who arrived at the tourney with kind words for the Hand and a six-pass joust that lasted long enough to impress the stands before Jace's final lance throw sent him into the dirt. He congratulated Jace graciously, which cost him nothing; he then saved Gaelor Targaryen's life by tackling Brant Costayne mid-assassination, which cost him rather more. He makes no secret of his broader appetites, a fact Ser Alester noted with mild amusement from a roadside inn and relayed to Jace with more detail than was strictly necessary.

name: Renrose Tyrell
title: Lord of Highgarden, Warden of the South
goals: Secure the position of Hand of the King under Visenor's future reign
Cement the Tyrell-Targaryen alliance through a marriage between their children
Maintain eyes on Visenor's movements through Leo's presence in Oldtown
Expand House Tyrell's influence across the Reach in the power vacuum left by the Hightower's collapse

relationships.visenor-targaryen: Pledged the full strength of the Reach behind Visenor's claim at the Mander's Pact, extracting the promise of the Handship and a future marriage alliance in return; views Visenor as a means to an end as much as a true ally.
relationships.leo-tyrell: Dispatched his fourteen-year-old son to Oldtown under the guise of education alongside Melessa Hightower — in practice, a political foothold and a pair of eyes inside the Hightower.
relationships.martyn-mullendore: Relies on Mullendore as a trusted sword arm operating in Visenor's orbit; Martyn's loyalty to the prince rather than to Renrose directly is a variable he has not yet been forced to reckon with.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Sees her as a piece to be positioned rather than a person; inserting Leo into her household is partly about influence over the last Hightower heir.

summary: Lord Renrose Tyrell is the calculating master of Highgarden, a man who weathered the Crown's punishment of his house — Derrin Hightower paid the price for the conspiracy, not the Tyrells — and emerged with his seat and his ambitions intact. At the Mander's Pact he bound himself to Visenor's cause in exchange for the Handship and a marriage between their children, making him the exiled prince's most powerful backer and most dangerous liability in equal measure. His decision to send Leo to Oldtown reveals his instinct to keep agents close to any power he cannot directly control — an instinct Visenor has already begun quietly working against.

name: Martyn Mullendore
title: Knight of the Reach
goals: Protect Visenor and ensure his survival in the Reach
Navigate the competing interests of Renrose Tyrell and the prince without openly defying either

relationships.visenor-targaryen: Recognised the disguised prince during the Oldtown street ambush and brought him to Melessa Hightower; has since ridden with him to Highgarden and now to Oldtown as part of his cover, making him one of the four people who know Visenor's true identity inside the Hightower.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Delivered Visenor to her in the hall where her brother was killed; their relationship is defined by that single fraught moment.
relationships.renrose-tyrell: Operates within Renrose's orbit but his demonstrated loyalty runs toward Visenor personally rather than to the Lord of Highgarden — a distinction that has not yet been tested openly.
relationships.leo-tyrell: Rode alongside Leo on the journey from Highgarden to Oldtown; their dynamic is that of an experienced knight tolerating a haughty fourteen-year-old.

summary: Ser Martyn Mullendore is a knight of the Reach who stumbled into Visenor's orbit by chance and chose loyalty over convenience. He led the City Watch patrol that intervened in the Oldtown alley ambush, recognised the disguised prince, and delivered him to Lady Melessa rather than to the authorities — a decision that has since drawn him fully into the conspiracy. He now rides as part of Visenor's cover retinue in Oldtown, one of only four people inside the Hightower who know Maester Arthur Sand is a prince of the blood.

name: Berholt Caswell
title: High Septon
traits: Politically cautious — not cowardly, but deliberate
Capable of shame when his principles and his caution have not aligned
goals: Deliver verdicts and guidance that he can honestly believe the gods would sanction
Preserve the Faith's independence without provoking a confrontation he cannot win
Act justly within the limits of what he believes is survivable — and wrestle privately with where that line sits

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Respects him as the steadiest hand in the room at the trial; aligned with his Wall verdict because it was the most just outcome he could honestly defend — not because Jace pressured him into it.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: A tense, unequal antagonism. Baelor pushed hard; Berholt held his ground with a serenity that infuriated the Grand Maester, but he was also aware he was holding ground on a verdict rather than on the larger question — Gaelor's unpunished sin — where he had already failed to act.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Never formally sanctioned him for Alysanne Hightower's murder — not from fear alone, but from a genuine uncertainty about whether an excommunication would serve the gods or simply detonate a crisis he could not contain. He is not sure he made the right call, and that uncertainty coloured everything he said at the trial.
relationships.brant-costayne: Saw in him a man who did what Berholt himself had not: acted on his convictions regardless of cost. That recognition, more than theology, drove him toward mercy.

summary: High Septon Berholt Caswell is a man of genuine faith and genuine limits — and he is honest enough with himself to know the difference. He is not a villain and not a coward in the simple sense; he is a man who has spent seventy-four years learning how much justice the world will actually bear, and who has sometimes let that calculation shade into inaction. His failure to sanction Gaelor for Alysanne Hightower's murder was not pure timidity — it was a considered judgment that the fallout would cost more than the principle was worth — but he is no longer entirely sure he was right, and that doubt sat with him throughout the trial. At the antechamber recess he argued for the Wall with quiet conviction, not to defy Baelor or please Jace, but because it was the most honest answer he could give the gods. A good man. Not an especially brave one. Aware of the gap.

name: Leo Tyrell
traits: Politically aware beyond his years — though not beyond his father's instruction
goals: Prove himself useful to his father's alliance with Visenor
Receive the education his father sent him to Oldtown for
Earn the respect of the older men around him

relationships.renrose-tyrell: Dispatched by his father to Oldtown ostensibly for his education alongside Melessa Hightower; in practice he is also his father's presence in the room, a role he is old enough to half-understand and young enough to play clumsily.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Knows him as Maester Arthur Sand, one of only four inside the Hightower aware of his true identity; volunteered to send for his father's swordsmen before Visenor quietly shut the idea down — his first lesson that the prince will not be managed.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Sent to be educated alongside her; the dynamic between a grieving fourteen-year-old lady and a haughty fourteen-year-old lord has not yet been established.
relationships.martyn-mullendore: Rode from Highgarden to Oldtown in his company; Martyn tolerates him.

summary: Leo Tyrell is fourteen years old and carries himself with the full weight of Highgarden behind him — which is to say, with a haughtiness that sits uneasily on his young shoulders. His father Renrose dispatched him to Oldtown under the banner of education alongside Melessa Hightower, but Leo is perceptive enough to sense the political dimension of the arrangement even if he cannot fully articulate it. His first instinct on arriving at the Hightower was to offer his father's swordsmen to Visenor — an offer that was politely and firmly declined, his first indication that the prince he is nominally serving has no intention of being dependent on House Tyrell.

name: Almar Larchmont
title: Maester
goals: Protect Melessa Hightower and see her established as the foremost lady of the Reach
Maintain Visenor's cover identity within the Hightower without fracture
Keep the knowledge of the prince's presence contained to the four who already hold it

relationships.visenor-targaryen: One of only four people inside the Hightower who know Maester Arthur Sand is Prince Visenor; sharp enough to cut off Melessa mid-sentence on the first morning before she exposed the prince's identity to the room.
relationships.melessa-hightower: His primary charge and loyalty; the speed with which he corrected her slip at breakfast suggests a long-established habit of protecting her from her own candour.
relationships.leo-tyrell: Present at the first breakfast meeting; his relationship with the Tyrell boy is not yet defined, though his instinct to keep Renrose's reach limited aligns with Visenor's own.

summary: Maester Almar serves as castle healer at the Hightower and is one of the four people inside the castle walls who know that the man calling himself Maester Arthur Sand is in fact Prince Visenor Targaryen. His composure under pressure was evident from the first morning: when Melessa began to address the prince by his true title at the breakfast table, Almar cut her off mid-word with a voice sharp enough to silence the room. His loyalties run first to Melessa and second to the success of the arrangement that keeps her safe — which, for now, means keeping Visenor's cover intact.

name: Baran Strong
title: Sworn Sword of Dragonstone
traits: Loyal to Those Who Treat Him Fairly
goals: Return to the Red Keep and to meaningful service
Prove his worth to Prince Gaelor

relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Offered a place in Gaelor's service at Dragonstone; Gaelor extended the invitation after hearing his grievance and assessing his size and bearing.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Acknowledged him as Lord Hand and was told plainly there is a place for him in the Red Keep — but that Gaelor does not get to make that decision unilaterally.
relationships.curtass-whent: Brawled with him inside the Red Keep; both were stripped of their white cloaks, though Baran was deemed the party in the right and exiled to Dragonstone rather than disgraced. He despised Whent and makes no pretense otherwise.
relationships.malaenar-targaryen: Has served as his sworn sword on Dragonstone since the exile; Malaenar regards him as one of the finest knights in the Seven Kingdoms and is openly reluctant to give him back.
relationships.alester-dayne: Met him at Dragonstone; needled him about the Kingsguard preferring pretty faces, and received a mild, unimpressed reply. Alester noted the size and filed it away.

summary: A near-seven-foot wall of muscle and grievance, Baran Strong was once a Kingsguard whose career ended in a brawl with Curtass Whent inside the Red Keep itself. Stripped of his white cloak but judged the wronged party, he was exiled to Dragonstone rather than disgraced outright — a distinction he appreciates and resents in equal measure. Prince Malaenar calls him one of the finest knights in the Seven Kingdoms. Prince Gaelor, after a single evening's conversation at the stables, decided to find out if that was true.

name: Tansy
goals: Secure her position beside Malaenar
Be acknowledged by the royal family, however reluctantly

relationships.malaenar-targaryen: His companion of two years; organized the nameday feast that summoned the royal family to Dragonstone without his prior knowledge, a move the family received with barely concealed contempt.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Called her 'your wench' before his brother and the entire hall; she held his gaze and did not flinch.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Caught his eye more than once during the evening; he extracted himself before anything could happen, aware of exactly what was at stake.

summary: A seventeen-year-old of no house and considerable ambition, Tansy has spent two years at Dragonstone as Malaenar Targaryen's companion. She organized his nameday feast and invited the royal family without asking him first — a gambit that put her at a high table with a king who called her a wench and a crown prince who looked at her the way men do when they are deciding not to. She showed no sign of finding either development discouraging.

name: Perric Bracken
title: Lord of Stone Hedge
goals: Press House Bracken's advantage over the Blackwoods wherever possible
Avoid Crown intervention

relationships.godfrey-blackwood: Ancient rivals; his men killed Godfrey's cousin near the border under circumstances he characterized as an accident and Godfrey characterized as murder. The Hand has offered him a trial by combat if he refuses to negotiate.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Has not yet responded to the Crown's envoy or the trial-by-combat challenge.
relationships.bethany-bracken: His niece, whose marriage to Oscar Tully recently tied House Bracken to the ruling Tully line.

summary: Lord Perric Bracken of Stone Hedge, whose men killed a Blackwood cousin near the border in circumstances that remain disputed. He called it an unfortunate accident during an altercation; Lord Godfrey Blackwood called it a deliberate provocation and brought the matter to the Hand of the King.
